cases.name: grouped_last_event returns the last events grouped by region
grouped_last_event with multiple groups returns the last events grouped by region and country
grouped_last_event with filters returns the last events filtered and grouped
max returns the max value
max with grouped_by_values returns the max value of the group
max with grouped_by_values nil returns the max value of the events without the property
max with filters returns the max value filtered
max with_count false returns the max value (count always returned)
grouped_max returns the max values and counts grouped by region
grouped_max with_count false returns the max values (count always returned)
grouped_max with multiple groups returns the max values grouped by region and country
grouped_max with filters returns the max values filtered and grouped
last returns the last event value and the events count
last with_count false returns the last value (count always returned)
last without events returns a nil value and a zero count
last when the last event has no value returns a nil value
last with filters returns the last filtered event value
grouped_last returns the last value and the events count for each region
grouped_last with_count false returns the last values (count always returned)
grouped_last with multiple groups returns the last value for each region and country
grouped_last with filters returns the last values filtered and grouped
sum returns the sum of event properties
sum with only duplicated transaction_id at another timestamp takes the event into account
sum with_count false returns the sum (count always returned)
sum with events before from_datetime excludes them by default
sum with events before from_datetime and use_from_boundary false includes them
sum with events before from_datetime and use_from_boundary set back to true excludes them
sum with events after to_datetime excludes them
sum with max_timestamp boundary uses max_timestamp instead of to_datetime
grouped_sum returns the sum of values grouped by region
grouped_sum with_count false returns the sums (count always returned)
grouped_sum with multiple groups returns the sums grouped by region and country
grouped_sum with filters returns the sums filtered and grouped
grouped_sum breakdown without grouped_by returns the sums by cloud
grouped_sum breakdown with grouped_by returns the sums per agent and cloud
grouped_count breakdown without grouped_by returns the counts by cloud
grouped_count breakdown with grouped_by returns the counts per agent and cloud
grouped_last breakdown without grouped_by returns the latest value with its cloud
grouped_last breakdown with grouped_by returns the latest value per agent with its cloud
grouped_max breakdown without grouped_by returns the max value by cloud
grouped_max breakdown with grouped_by returns the max value per agent and cloud
grouped_unique_count breakdown without grouped_by returns the unique counts by cloud
grouped_unique_count breakdown with grouped_by returns the unique counts per agent and cloud
grouped_weighted_sum breakdown without grouped_by returns the weighted sums by cloud
